notes: «نَصُّ آخَرُ» is a stray label and «16 -» the report number: both left out
ruling needed: the saying is Haydar's own first-person account of a scene in which the Imam «أبو إبراهيم» speaks and acts; the Imam is in the scene, not in the chain
«أبي» is the compiler's father, named only by relation
the closing remark «قال علي بن الحكم ماتَ حيدر وهو شاك» is a remark, not a route
